APhO-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Theoretical problems only (experimental problems are not included yet). Each statement is transcribed from the official English paper of the organisers and checked part by part against its page images. Statements only: no solutions, answers or marking schemes.

BPhO-R2-problems.json.verification_notes: Round 2 of the British Physics Olympiad (BPhO), the selection paper for the UK IPhO team, dated by the year printed on the paper (sat in January from 2011). Questions numbered as printed. Statements transcribed from the official BPhO papers and checked against their page images. Statements only: no mark schemes or solutions. Problems © British Physics Olympiad.

EuPhO-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Theoretical problems only (experimental problems are not included yet). Each statement is transcribed from the official English paper and checked part by part against its page images. Statements only: no solutions, answers or marking schemes.

Greece-EEF-problems.json.verification_notes: National final of the Panhellenic Physics Competition for Lyceum students of the Hellenic Physical Society (Ένωση Ελλήνων Φυσικών), Grade 12 (Γ΄ Λυκείου) paper; «Δημόκριτος» since 2025. Problems numbered as printed, including the data-analysis problem printed in the paper. English translation of the official Greek papers, checked against their page images. Statements only: no solutions. Problems © Ένωση Ελλήνων Φυσικών.

IPhO-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Theoretical problems only (experimental problems are not included yet). Each statement is transcribed from the official English paper and checked part by part against its page images; for the early years without an official English paper the source is the IPhO compilation and is labelled as such. Statements only: no solutions, answers or marking schemes.

NBPhO-problems.json.verification_notes: Theoretical problems of the Nordic-Baltic Physics Olympiad (formerly the Estonian-Finnish Olympiad), numbered as printed; experimental problems are not included. Statements transcribed from the organisers' papers and checked against their page images. Statements only: no solutions.

PLANCKS-problems.json.verification_notes: The international final of PLANCKS, the theoretical physics competition for undergraduate and master students organised by the International Association of Physics Students (IAPS). Statements transcribed from the exam papers published by the organisers (archive of the Institute of Physics, plancks.uk) and checked against their page images. Statements only: no solutions.

USAPhO-problems.json.verification_notes: The USAPhO exam of the American Association of Physics Teachers (AAPT), Parts A and B, numbered per part as printed (A1–A3 → Part A 1–3). Statements transcribed from the official AAPT exam PDFs and checked against their page images. Statements only: no solutions or answers. Problems © AAPT.
